item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windier over the region. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will bring thundery showers to southern China. The easterly airstream is expected to be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be hot and brighter over Guangdong early next week.
